tagline: Universal Document Fusion, Vector Engineering & Offline PDF Suite for Anything
summary: DocuFlow Studio Pro introduces Adobe-class document engineering to the Anything ecosystem: universal heterogeneous document fusion, visual PDF page reordering and splitting, offline OCR vision, 1-to-1 batch office conversion, security & compression, and CAD blueprint rendering.
newFeatures: Adobe Creative Cloud visual design identity with signature Df monogram tile and specular rim
PDF Page Studio & Visual Splitter: Thumbnail grid to reorder, rotate 90°, delete pages, extract ranges (e.g., 1-3, 5), or split all to ZIP
Offline OCR Vision Extractor: Client-side optical character recognition via Tesseract for scanned and flattened PDFs
1-to-1 Batch Office Converter: Convert dozens of Word and Excel documents to individual PDFs with direct folder saving or ZIP export
Security & Optimization Suite: Diagonal watermark stamps, sequential page numbering, multi-tier document compression, and user password protection
In-App Instant PDF Previewer: Built-in high-DPI canvas viewer with page navigation, zoom, and rotation
Heterogeneous Multi-Document Staggered Fusion: Combine arbitrary combinations of Word, Excel, CAD DXF, Images, Text, and PDFs into one publication
AutoCAD CAD-to-PDF Studio: Direct vector DXF parsing with Blueprint, Monochrome, and Layer Color themes up to A1 paper size
improvements: Native Anything ecosystem integration with customized startup loader and auto-update support
100% Client-side sandbox execution with zero cloud uploads and local PDF.js worker
Fluid Windows 11 Liquid Glass UI with SF Pro Display typography and frosted scrollbars
fixes: Resolved tab switching synchronization and titlebar state in master workspace
Fixed TypeScript ArrayBuffer and BlobPart compatibility across all studio modules
